description: Create a one-shot Price Alert on toolforex (push + in-app notification when the mid price crosses the target; checked every minute). Step 3 of the /routine: one alert at the entry zone of each directional pair in today's plan. direction ABOVE fires when price >= target, BELOW when price <= target — pick the side the price must travel to reach the entry. Supported symbols: EURUSD, GBPUSD, USDJPY, AUDUSD, USDCAD, NZDUSD, USDCHF, EURGBP, EURJPY, GBPJPY, GBPAUD, XAUUSD, XAGUSD, USOIL, BTCUSD, ETHUSD. Limit 5 active alerts (20 for VIP). Requires a personal SocialForex API token. Create one at /mt5 (section "Connect an AI assistant (MCP)") and add it to the MCP client as header `Authorization: Bearer sfmcp_...`.
name: set_price_alert
title: Set a price alert
